Current position, 800 southwest of Mizutori Island.@Entering the test airspace. Operation normal.
Saika
The Steel Dragons' Hagane has engaged the enemy@off Kozu Island. Please keep a sharp lookout.
Roger.
In peacetime, there'd have been@no need to rush them.
Will they be all right, in this situation...?
The surface isn't cut off from space the way it was@by the <Atrum Exterior> in the last war.@There should be no problem.
Besides, that device is essential@for dealing with the Rabulpaila.
...Yes, you're right.
Gravity quake detected in the airspace ahead.@Signs of a spatial transfer confirmed.
Right on time.
Sean
...It seems to have succeeded.
Eun
Confirming coordinates... plus 0020 from the planned@point. Deviation within expected range.
TD Hovering at current altitude.@Check all systems at once.
Understood, Captain.
...Lieutenant Yon Gebana.@The space-to-Earth transfer test using the spatial@transfer device provided by Zovorg is complete.
Once again, thank you for your cooperation.
Not at all. I was only following my Master's orders.
Ghost 1 to Dragon 2.@We confirm your transfer arrival. Area is clear.@Return to Izu Base immediately.
Captain, a message from Major Gilliam.
...Major, checking the ship's systems@will take some time.
The situation has changed. Commander Laker Randolf@will explain the details after you return.
Understood.@XO, suspend the work. We're returning to Izu Base.
Earth Federation Army Far East Command, Izu Base
Izu Base - Interior
Geez, oversleeping is one thing, but this?@Do you know what time it is, big brother?
Shaddup, it's not like I'm goin' to school.@Besides, I'm not seein' Major Kai@till the afternoon now, remember?
Morning, you two... Well, it's not really morning.
When did you two get up, Akemi, Akimi?
Around six, I guess.
Huh? That early?
Yeah... I was tired, but I couldn't sleep much.@Once I got in bed, I was wide awake.
Whenever I closed my eyes,@I'd remember the battle...
Them hittin' us one more time late at night didn't help.
(...Kota and Shoko could sleep, though.@Is that because they're used to it...?)
By the way, where's Touya and the others?
Major Gilliam called them in this morning@to continue their questioning.
I see... Arado, you were there for the Granteed@investigation, right? Did you find anything out?
In the end, it wouldn't move for me, Seolla,@Lieutenant Hugo or Lieutenant Aqua. Also, it looks@like it was built a really long time ago...
They say it has a device similar to@the <Sympathia> in Josh's@Aile Chevalier.
That robot was built way back when?@Sure doesn't look it.
Same here.
Oh, right. The Hiryu Custom came back to Izu@late last night, and the Hagane this morning.
So all the <Steel Dragons> mother ships are here.@Where've they been all this time?
The Hagane was on a shakedown cruise with its new@lineup, under a new fleet commander and captain.@The Hiryu Custom's mission is classified, even to us.
The Hagane changed captains?
Yes, Colonel Ginto Kitaumi. The former captain,@Major Tetsuya Onodera, became the XO.
Why's that?
Taking the blame for <The Former President's Accident>...@So Lieutenant Colonel Lefina Enfield, our commander,@was replaced by Brigadier General Miles Boothroyd.
Rumor has it the new commander's a real stiff.
Hmph, that's a pain.
Hey, if the Hagane and Hiryu Custom are back,@that means the <SRX Team> and@<ATX Team> are on this base, right?
Yup. Wanna meet 'em?
Well, sure, of course.
You got your ID card, right?@Swing by the base cafeteria or lounge later.
Got it.@I'll go once the Soul Saber's maintenance is done.
Izu Base - Underground Hangar
Laker
...I see.@Seeing it in person, it's clear it's not much@different from an Earth-made aircraft.
Yes.
Sakae
Can the Drift Wing be activated?
Eric
Its control method resembles Earth machines, you see.@Give me permission and I'll do it.
How dangerous are the black boxes?
It's unknown technology, you see.@We won't know until we try starting the main engine.
Jinpu
It ain't gonna blow up or anything, is it?
If it were built that way, you see,@Mogami's offshore plant would be blown to bits.
Well, that's true.
Then, Doctor...@please begin your investigation of the Drift Wing.
Mm-hmm.
(If they called me here too...@that means they want me helpin' Dr. Wan.)
Furthermore, as I stated before, this matter@stays confidential among those involved.
That includes our comatose sleeping beauty.@Do not reveal it to Commander Miles or anyone@else in the Steel Dragons.
Are you sure about this?
Yes, those are orders from the Joint Chiefs of Staff.@With so many secrets crossing paths like this,@it's not good to hand out unconfirmed information.
Roger.
(Geez...@I sure got dragged into somethin' crazy.@Gotta make sure Akimi and Akemi don't catch on...)
So, how was the Hiryu Custom's spatial transfer?
Nothin' to it. Over in a flash.@More importantly, I hear the Hagane had it pretty rough.
Before we get into that, meet my new recruits.@Lieutenant Calvina Coulange@and Festenia Muse.
...Nice to meet you.
Tenia
Just call me Tenia!
She's just a kid... and a civilian, too.@Seriously, she's a member of the PTX Team?
Yeah, there are a lot of circumstances.
Lieutenant Calvina and Tenia are survivors@of the attack on <Ashurey Kreuzer>.
What...!?
Does that ring a bell?
J-Just wait here a moment.@There are some people I want you to meet, Lieutenant.
What's with the rush...
(People I should meet...?@I don't know anyone at this Izu Base.)
Well, let me introduce Octopus Team's members.@I'm the leader, Lieutenant Katina Tarrasque.
I'm Lieutenant Russel Bergman.
Lieutenant Tasuku Shinguji, at your service!
I am Lieutenant Leona Garstein.
(A young team...@Though so is Lieutenant Irm's PTX Team.)
Lieutenant, I've heard of the ace who distinguished@herself in the <DC War> and <L5 Campaign>, the White Lynx.
That's ancient history.@Until recently, I was a test pilot@for Ashurey Kreuzer.
But you're not a former Lieutenant, so...@you're back in the military?
Yes. I found a reason to fight in the Bellzelute.@Along with this girl.
Katia
Tenia!!
What!?
Melua
Tenia... It's really you, Tenia...!
K-Katia, Melua! You're alive?!
I should be saying that...!
Thank goodness... Really...!
How did you two get out of there...?!
Good question. When we finished the Bellzelute test@and returned to Ashurey Kreuzer,@there wasn't a single survivor...
Hold on, I'm not following.
Could you explain so the rest of us understand,@Lieutenant Calvina?
Fine. At Ashurey Kreuzer, I was involved@in testing a humanoid mobile weapon@called the Bellzelute...
Then, a few days before its first field test on the Moon,@the three of them here... Katia, Melua and Tenia...@came to the Moon from Earth.
Their parents were Ashurey staff.@I thought it was some factory tour, but then they@said they'd put Tenia in the Bellzelute. I was stunned.
What for?
I didn't know then, but the Bellzelute's@man-machine interface and power source@won't start unless Tenia's aboard.
And the reason is still unknown...@The Ashurey staff never@explained it to me.
Tenia, do you know anything?
Nope. I'd never heard of or seen the Bellzelute@or the Cytron System before going@to Ashurey Kreuzer.
Cytron...? What the heck's that?
The Bellzelute's man-machine interface.@Supposedly it feeds info on using the system@and the machine straight into your head.
Not that I feel anything, though.
(Just as I thought...@Tenia's the same as me and Touya...)
So after Tenia and I went out for the Bellzelute's@field test, an unidentified humanoid mobile weapon@attacked Ashurey Kreuzer.
By the time we got back, it was too late.
That humanoid mobile weapon...
Code name Thorn. No matching data.@Some say it's a Zovorg machine.
I'll never forgive it.@The gray <Thorn> that took my comrades' lives...@I'll take it down with my own hands...!
(So that's why she rejoined the military...)
Now it's my turn to ask.@Katia, Melua... how did you two@survive?
Probably before you came back, Calvina...@Melua and I were rescued by Seldoa.
Seldoa? Seldoa Shiun is safe too?@Then what about Ally... Alistair Lynx?
...Only Seldoa was aboard@the Granteed.
Granteed? What's that?
A large combat robot.@So you didn't know about it@either, Calvina...
(What's going on...?@A machine I didn't know about was being@developed at Ashurey...?)
He put us in the Granteed@and took us to his house@in Japan...
But we were attacked by the enemy there...@and Seldoa, who was badly wounded, passed away.
Are you...@with Ashurey Kreuzer?
And you are?
Touya Shiun... Seldoa Shiun's son.@Please, tell me what you know about my father.
Sorry, but I can't give you what you're hoping for.@Seldoa headed the project I was involved in,@but I only met him a handful of times.
The Granteed is a combat robot,@and you were a test pilot, right?@Don't you know something?
My father... never told me anything.@Then out of nowhere he left me that robot,@and I ended up fighting unknown enemies...
Why does this have to happen to me...@I just don't understand...
...Think you're the hero of some tragedy?
Huh?
So you lost one person. What of it?
C-Calvina...
I lost a lot of comrades.@I don't need a kid who badgers people with@I want to know, I want to know nagging at me.
Y-You've never had...@your parent go cold right next to you@in the same cockpit, have you...?!
Touya...
That's enough, both of you.@In times like these, everyone's got a painful memory@or two. Comparing them won't do any good.
(Geez...@Maybe I'd better take Calvina and clear out.)
Okay, PTX Team meeting time.@Let's go, Calvina.
What? This suddenly...
Just come on already.
Izu Base - Mess Hall
Is that for real?
Yeah, I was shocked when I actually saw it in space.@It had huge wings sprouting out of it, too.
But during <The Sealing War>... Ares Geist ended up@absorbed into the <Adamatron>, didn't it?
So it may be a different one...@a copy, or an imitation.
But it came from the direction of the Cross Gate.@Isn't it more natural to think it came out@of the Gate?
Then how did Ares Geist come back?@We wiped out the Adamatron ourselves...
That's what I'd like to know.
U-Um, excuse me!@You're from the <SRX Team> and <ATX Team>, right?!
Yeah... And you are?
I-I'm Akimi Akatsuki, here from the@direction of Mogami Heavy Industries!
From the direction...?
Wait, are you two... twins?
Yes. I'm the older sister, Akemi Akatsuki.
Mogami Heavy Industries... That's a mid-sized@heavy machinery maker, isn't it?
Yeah. We're test pilots there@for the Mighty Walker.
Mighty Walker?
It's a mass-produced <Super Robot> Mogami's developing.
Wait, the one sitting in the hangar?@Solid build, nice machine. It's even got a handsome@face. A classic super robot, through and through!
Th-Thank you!@It's called the Soul Saber.
Ooh, nice.@The head looked kinda like a plane...@Does it separate and fly, maybe?
(Sharp...)
Actually, that was the plan...@but there are other areas we need to tune first,@so it's on hold for now.
For now, it's built to come right off during refits,@and it can serve as an escape pod too.
Which of you is piloting it?
Actually, we both are. The prototype has a special@two-seat layout so we can monitor every part@of the machine and gather data.
The Soul Saber can be switched between FF,@a high-mobility close-combat setup, and GG,@a heavy-armor long-range setup...
I'm the main pilot for FF,@and Akemi's the main pilot for GG.
Huh, that just keeps sounding better!
I'm glad to hear that@from Lieutenant Ryusei Date.
You know who I am?
Yeah, I read your interview@in Man-Machine Journal too.
Oh, that...
(Aya and Rai rewrote half my draft, though...)
So Ryusei's your idol, huh?
Yeah, kind of.
That's amazing, Ryu.
Nah, it's not like I'm running@the SRX Team all by myself.
Akimi... Could it be that you're thinking@of enlisting in the military?
It's not that, exactly. I just want to see@the Soul Saber through to the end...
I want to finish it properly,@as a machine that protects the Earth.
Like I said, once we deliver Unit 1 to the military,@our job's done for now.
Yeah, but...
Look, I don't really know the whole story,@so this might be way off base, but...
Whatever job you end up doing,@I think you should hold on to@wanting to protect the Earth.
Y-Yes...
So, Doctor... what did you need?
Marion
Actually, certain data was discovered@in <Grand Christmas>.
Data?
Yes. A development plan for a new Gespenst@that <Shadow Mirror> had been working on.
Why would something like that be@in Grand Christmas...?
Egret Fehu of the <Gaia Savers> had contact with@Shadow Mirror at the <Earth Cradle> during@the <Inspector Incident>, after all...
Perhaps he obtained the development plan's data@by some means or other.
Is it genuine?
Yes, I confirmed it with Axel Almer.@Though he says the actual machine@was never built.
...I see where this is going.@You intend to develop that Gespenst@at the <Tesla Reich Institute>.
Not quite.@It's about to roll out.
I personally took a liking to its specs,@so I've been developing it@as part of the Halloween Plan.
(...If the Doctor likes it,@it must be quite the wild horse.)
Once it rolls out, I'll send it your way.@Please break it in and gather data for me.
Why me? If it's a Shadow Mirror machine,@wouldn't it be better to leave it to Axel?
He turned me down.@He says he has no wish to ride a Gespenst.
(...Figures.)
Also, it was apparently designed originally@as a custom machine for a certain person.
Then that person should...
Unfortunately, I'm told they aren't in this world.
...For a Gespenst, I'd think Major Kai@of the Instructors would be the right fit.
I'm asking because I have faith in you.@Besides, some of its weapons resemble the Alt's.
...Understood. What's the machine called?
Gespenst Type-H...@Better known as the Gespenst Haken.
Now then, Roa. Tell us about the Crystal Dragoon@we encountered at Yakumo Base.
Roa
Very well... <Dark Brain> once led an army,@with countless monstrous servants in its ranks.@He's one of its top officers in terms of strength.
How many of these officers are there?
As far as I know, twelve...@Of those, I'm certain I destroyed seven.
And the other four, not counting@the Crystal Dragoon?
I don't know.
What's that supposed to mean?
...As you all know, Dark Brain's goal is to destroy@intelligent life across many worlds@and absorb their negative thoughts...
To do that more efficiently, it needed@a more advanced dimensional transfer ability.
Neither the Compatible Kaiser nor Dark Brain@could open dimensional gates at will, correct?
That's exactly why it tried to take the Kaiser's@Overgate Engine and elevate its own@dimensional transfer ability.
And I cornered Dark Brain...@and launched a suicide attack with the Kaiser.
Meanwhile, my comrades fought fiercely@against the Dark Brain Army,@with our mothership at the core.
A mothership...
It's called the deity ship Grandred Fenossa.
A d-deity ship? What's that?
A huge battleship housing the soul of a god@said to have given our race power and wisdom...
It was the core of our forces,@and our spiritual anchor as well.
A mechanical god... is that it?
That sounds just like...@the <Gan Eden> Shoko and the others@fought in the Sealing War...
Grandred Fenossa has no will of its own.@We excavated a divine body holding immense@energy and built it into the ship's weapons.
So what became of the deity ship?
I fell into this world, so I can't say.@Whether it defeated the Dark Brain Army, or...
You sayin' it got wiped out?
As long as the Crystal Dragoon survives,@I can't rule it out completely.
Hold on, it's also possible they trashed@every last one of 'em except him!
Right.@If it uses a god's power, it must be@super strong, right?
That's true, but that battle was so fierce@that even Grandred Fenossa@was forced onto the defensive.
After all, I lost my own body@and Emi as well...
The Crystal Dragoon appeared at Yakumo alone.@If any of its forces remained, it'd be natural@for it to have brought them along.
The Major's right.@He's the only one left, I bet!
(I hope that's the case.)
But he said his goal wasn't revenge@for Dark Brain, right? Then why did he@come after Shoko and the rest of us...?
Same as that brain-faced jerk, obviously.@He wanted the Kaiser's@Overgate Engine.
(To gain dimensional transfer ability...?)
(Then how did the Crystal Dragoon@come to this world...?)
Oh, Lieutenant Kyosuke.
What did Dr. Radom want?@Don't tell me she got a lead on@where the boss went?
No... She asked me to break in a new Gespenst.
I see... I wonder what kind of machine it is?
I'm curious too.@I used to pilot Gespenst types, back in the day.
You'll find out soon enough.@...So, what about Arieil?
See for yourself.
Good morning, Lieutenant Kyosuke.
Looks like you woke up fine.
Yes, I wasn't asleep for very long...
Sorry, but I'm going to need you to work.
Yes... I've already heard about the Ares Geist.
How's your body?
According to Dr. Wan, a newly synthesized drug@can hold back my symptoms for about two months.
I see.
So, Arieil... about what we were discussing earlier.
Yes...@Judging from the data, I don't believe <AI1>@is inside the revived Ares Geist.
On what grounds?
In the battle at <Fabula Foresse>,@the Ares Geist was swallowed up by Garberus.
If AI1 had been revived, its appearance would@be its form from that time, or something@close to Garberus...
I think part of its body should show@something along those lines.
(Same as my own view...)
Right now, we don't know where on Earth@the Ares Geist is hiding. You'll stand by@at Izu until we get more information.
Understood.
(If the Ares Geist has been revived...@Duban, are you also..........?)
Lieutenant Irm, there's something I want to ask.
Is it about work?
You're the one who said the PTX Team@was having a meeting, Lieutenant.@Yet all you're doing is drinking tea.
Aren't you the serious one. So?
What was that Ares Geist we saw in space?
Oh, right, I never explained it properly.@Okay, let's take it in order...@First, ever heard of the <Gaia Savers>?
The President's own unit, separate from the Federation@Army, right? They bragged about repelling a <Zovorg>@force that tried to take Paris.
Right. The Ares Geist is the commander unit@of one of the Gaia Savers' squads,@Beta Saber.
That? That monster?
Back in <The Sealing War>, it looked@a little more streamlined than that...
It still looks like the <Einst> to me.
Actually, there is a connection.@The Ares Geist's generator,@the Fau Kern...
repurposes the core of the Jetzt Regisseur,@which you could call a dead copy of a large Einst.
That's insane.
Well, the Gaia Savers themselves were like that.@A lot of their members and the mobile weapons@they used had shady origins.
Come to think of it, I heard the Gaia Savers ended@up fighting the Federation Army and got wiped out.
Yes... The Steel Dragons detachment I was with@took part in the final battle against them.
The Gaia Savers' real leader,@Arteul Steinbeck, wasn't from Earth.@He was from <Balmar>...
His goal was to take the Cross Gate@found in Antarctica for himself.
To that end, he fused the technologies@the Gaia Savers had gathered and created@a giant mobile weapon called the <Adamatron>.
And the Ares Geist had been@absorbed into it.
And you people beat@this Adamatron thing?
Yes, inside the Cross Gate... in the boundary space.
So an enemy you thought you'd beaten@has come back from the underworld.@Did the Ares Geist have a pilot?
Yes, Duban Org of the Gaia Savers@piloted it.
That guy and the ATX Team's Arieil@are Idealand...
Put simply, they're test subjects for@artificial humans with superior abilities.@The two of them are like brother and sister.
Artificial humans...?@I've heard rumors about that kind of thing...@So they really exist.
...There's one right in front of you, Lieutenant.
No way... You too?
That's right, but I'm an artificial human@of a different category from the Idealand.
You say that so casually.@Don't you ever question your own existence?
I used to... But thanks to everyone@in the Steel Dragons,@I can be here like this.
...What touching camaraderie.@So, what about Duban and Arieil?
She was with the Gaia Savers originally too...@but she realized what they really were,@deserted, and joined the Steel Dragons.
After that, Lieutenant Arieil fought@Duban's Ares Geist alongside us.
So is he still in it now?
I didn't sense any human thoughts@from that Ares Geist.
So it's unmanned...@Or maybe, true to the name Geist,@there's a ghost aboard.
(If the Ares Geist has been revived,@then the Adamatron that absorbed it...@and that man, too...)
(No, that can't be.@<Euzeth> was destroyed back then...)
Tsugumi
Tsugumi Takakura, Ibis Douglas,@and Sleigh Presty, reporting in.
Thank you for coming.@I've just sent over the Hyperlion's hangar@and room assignments.
Should we move it onto the Hiryu right away?
Right.
Then, Ibis, Sleigh... I'll leave it to you.
Understood.
We're off.
...Um, what is this mission about?@Major Gilliam, who made the request,@didn't tell us any details...
I'm in the same boat.@Once the brass finish their meeting,@there may be an announcement...
I see...
Izu Base, Base Commander's Office
Miles
Lieutenant Colonel Lefina, I take it the space@transfer device provided by the <Zovorg>@worked without any problems.
Yes, Commander.
Their show of good faith was genuine.
Hmph... The Earth Sphere suffered massive damage@from the <Inspectors> and <Guest>. Top-tier <EOT> or@not, a transfer device or two can't make up for that.
Still, it does make the Steel Dragons more mobile@and lets you respond swiftly in an emergency.
At the same time, you are entrusted with@a space transfer device that could prove@decisive in a war between Earthlings.
Unlike during <The Sealing War>, that measure@was taken because the Steel Dragons now report@directly to the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
Then shouldn't the Hagane also@be given a space transfer device?
(...That goes without saying.)
Many Zovorg ships have been sunk in the wars@so far. Some may obtain transfer devices from them@and start building their own.
I share that concern, and I've submitted@a request to the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
I see.@Now, to the main topic... but before that,@I have a report.
After the Sealing War, a full-scale@reinvestigation was to begin at Fabula Foresse,@the ruins beneath the Antarctic ice...
Four days ago, it suddenly exploded.
Tetsuya
What did you say...!?
An accident?
No.
This grows more troubling by the minute.
Then it was attacked by someone...
The ruins' security cameras captured nothing.
Currently the cavern where <Fabula Foresse>@stood is buried under collapsed ice, so even@an on-site inspection is nearly impossible...
Dr. Clifford Gygax, who was on site, suspects that@a large quantity of explosives had been planted@in advance in the unexplored part of the ruins.
Did they go off automatically,@or were they detonated by someone?@Which is it?
Unknown. But a Federation Army unit will be sent@soon, and a reinvestigation will be conducted@in the presence of Dr. Gygax and his team.
Will Joshua Radcliff and@Cliana Rimskaya be taking part as well?
Yes. At Major Gilliam's recommendation,@the Geant Chevalier will be unsealed@and deployed to the site.
They're on their way from Antarctica to@Izu Base right now to receive the machine.
Will the Steel Dragons be heading@to Antarctica as well?
No. You are being given a top-secret mission@by the Earth Federation Government and@the Joint Chiefs. ...Vice Commander, bring him in.
Sir!
(I've heard nothing about this.@The Steel Dragons now report directly@to the Joint Chiefs of Staff!)
Bryan
Hello, everyone.
Former President Midcrid...!
It's been a while,@Lieutenant Colonel Lefina Enfield.
Y-Yes...
